functionalRequirement: If the validation fails, system shall prompt "Wrong OTP".

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must display the OTP error message in a clear, readable font with high contrast (minimum WCAG 2.1 AA color contrast ratio of 4.5:1) within 0.5 seconds of validation failure.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures users can quickly and clearly understand the reason for OTP validation failure.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must log each OTP validation attempt, capturing timestamp, user ID, and result (success/failure) with immutable audit trail.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides security tracking for authentication attempts and potential fraud detection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must allow a maximum of 3 consecutive OTP validation attempts before temporarily blocking the user account for 15 minutes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Prevents brute force attacks while maintaining user accessibility.

functionalRequirement: Information on remaining job posting time and CV access shall be reportable

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide 100% accurate reporting of remaining job posting time and CV access status for all active job postings.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures comprehensive and reliable reporting of critical job application information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must generate reports on job posting time and CV access within 2 seconds for queries involving up to 500 concurrent job postings.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides timely access to important job application tracking information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: The reporting interface must display remaining job posting time in a clear, human-readable format (e.g., "2 days, 5 hours remaining") with countdown timer.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps users easily understand and track job posting deadlines.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Analysability: The reporting system must support export of job posting and CV access reports in at least three standard formats (CSV, PDF, XML) for further analysis.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enables flexible data extraction and analysis of job posting information.
